gloss: slow season; off-peak period; slack period

definitions.gloss: slow season; off-peak period; slack period
definitions.explanation: a time of year when business or activity is at its lowest level

examples.japanese: {閑散期|かんさんき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。
examples.english: Traveling during the off-season is cheaper.

BUSINESS STRATEGY:
Many businesses use {閑散期|かんさんき} for staff training, renovations, or offering discounts to attract customers. Travel and hospitality industries often have significant price differences between ⟦{繁忙期|はんぼうき}→繁忙期：08366_hanbouki⟧ and {閑散期|かんさんき}.
